_comment: Copy to the API folder on the server as appsettings.Production.json and fill in the <...> values. Never commit the real file (it is in .gitignore).

ConnectionStrings.Default: Server=<SQL server address from Plesk → Databases>;Database=<database name>;User Id=<database user>;Password=<database password>;TrustServerCertificate=True;MultipleActiveResultSets=true

Jwt.Key: <at least 32 random characters — e.g. a new GUID typed twice without dashes>

Seed.AdminPassword: <only used if the database has no admin yet; otherwise leave empty>
